given: the stock record still carries the combined inventory_code column before the migration
then: the stock record no longer exposes a combined inventory_code column, and batch_number and serial_number are the first-class, separately addressable columns in its place

independence.rationale: AC1-AC3 assert the new columns' values are correct; AC4 asserts the old combined column is actually dropped. A migration could add and backfill the new columns while leaving the combined column in place, so retirement fails independently of the backfill outcomes.

architectural_notes: Infra layer: asserts the terminal schema shape after the up revision on the shared branch, inspected via app/repositories / column introspection. The drop of inventory_code is the last step of the same atomic add+backfill+drop transaction so no row is left un-backfilled before the column disappears; app/models/stock.py replaces inventory_code with the two first-class nullable columns. Owner modules: migrations/versions/*, app/models/stock.py. Verified by a kind:behavior real-branch test on the shared branch in its UP state (column absent, batch_number/serial_number present).
